title: Smart JSON Fixer, Formatter & Schema Validator
target_pain: Developers, prompt engineers, and data analysts frequently get broken JSON from LLMs, APIs, or messy logs containing trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, markdown wrappers, or missing closing brackets.
key_features: Strip Markdown code block wrappers automatically
Fix trailing commas, single quotes, and unquoted keys
Convert smart/curly quotes to standard double quotes
Real-time syntax validation and error highlighting
One-click copy to clipboard and instant file download
